about.title: The bridge between countryside and city
about.p1: ValorRural was born from the wish to shorten the distance between those who produce and those who consume. We believe local farming is the future of sustainable food and that every direct purchase strengthens not only the rural economy, but also trust between people.
about.p2: Our platform was designed to be simple, transparent and fair. Every review is verified by proof of purchase. Every farmer is a partner with a face and a story.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.desc: We reduce the ecological footprint by removing middlemen and large logistics chains.

community.title: Community
community.desc: We connect real people: conscious consumers and dedicated producers.

trust.title: Trust
trust.desc: Only buyers can leave reviews, so reviews are authentic and reliable.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To make fresh, quality farm produce accessible and affordable, creating a digital market that values the work of small and medium Portuguese farmers while offering consumers a transparent and trustworthy shopping experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be the leading platform connecting producers and consumers in Portugal, contributing to a fairer, more sustainable and community-based food system.

impact.title: Social impact
impact.text: Every transaction on ValorRural strengthens the local economy, preserves traditional farming practices and reduces food waste by shortening the supply chain.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.text: By cutting out middlemen and transport distances, we help bring about a significantly lower carbon footprint in the food sector.
